Print an hgsi_advanced object

Source: R/hgsi-run.r
print.hgsi_advanced.Rd

Console summary of a completed [hbr_advanced_decision()] or [hbr_cross_design()] run: evaluation labels, traits, models, parent and cross counts, block and set summaries, genetic-map source and any warnings recorded during the run.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'hgsi_advanced'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An `hgsi_advanced` object.

...

Ignored.

Value

`x`, invisibly.

Examples

x <- structure(
  list(evaluation_label = c(YLD = "honest_discovery_in_fold"),
       traits = "YLD",
       model_used = c(YLD = "gblup"),
       ids = sprintf("IND%02d", 1:5),
       parents = data.frame(id = sprintf("IND%02d", 1:5), index = 5:1),
       crosses = data.frame(parent_a = "IND01", parent_b = "IND02",
                            uc = 1.2),
       map_source = "bundled rice map",
       warnings = character(0),
       output_dir = tempdir()),
  class = c("hgsi_advanced", "list"))
print(x)
#> <hgsi_advanced>
#>   evaluation   : YLD=honest_discovery_in_fold
#>   traits       : YLD
#>   models       : YLD=gblup
#>   n individuals: 5
#>   parents      : 5 ranked
#>   crosses      : 1
#>   map source   : bundled rice map
#>   output       : /tmp/RtmpZq5roG
